Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 14-Jun-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2025  
  SUBJECT: PHY 1071/PHY_1071 - ENGINEERING PHYSICS  
  (MAKE-UP)  
  ENGINEERING PHYSICS [PHY 1071-PHY]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                With a necessary diagram, derive an expression for angle of acceptance and numerical aperture.           (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
1B)                A three level laser emits light of wavelength 550 nm. (a) What is the ratio of population of the upper (4)  
  level (E2 ) to that of the lower level (E1 ) in laser transition, at 300 K? (b) At what temperature the  
  ratio of the population of E2 to that of E1 becomes half?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
1C)                A ruby laser emits light at a wavelength of 694.4 nm. If a laser pulse is emitted for 12.0 ps and the    (2)  
  energy release per pulse is 150 mJ, what is the length of the pulse, and how many photons are  
  there in each pulse?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2A)                Define (i) group speed and (ii) phase speed of a wave packet. Show that the group speed of a wave (4)  
  packet is equal to the particle speed for a free non- relativistic quantum particle.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2B)                Molybdenum has a work function of 4.2 eV.                                                                (4)  
  i) Find the cut off wavelength and cut off frequency for the photoelectric effect.  
  ii) What is the stopping potential if the incident light has wavelength of 180 nm? (1 eV = 1.6x10-19 J  
  $$and h=6.63x10-34 J-s)$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2C)                Illustrate the de Broglie concept of wave properties of particles.                                       (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3A)                Apply the Schrödinger equation to a particle in a one-dimensional "box" of length L and obtain the       (4)  
  energy values of the particle.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
$$3B)                The J = 0 to J = 1 rotational transition of the CO molecule occurs at a frequency of 1.15 x 1011Hz.      (4)$$  
  
  Page 1 of 3

Use this information to;  
  i) Calculate the moment of inertia of the molecule.  
  ii) Calculate the bond-length of the molecule.  
  iii) What happens if another photon of frequency 1.15 x 1011 Hz is incident on the CO molecule  
  $$while it is in the J = 1 state?$$  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3C)             A proton in a one-dimensional box has an energy of 400 keV in its first excited state. How wide is        (2)  
  the box?  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)             Explain atomic, ionic, orientational and space charge polarizability using suitable diagram.              (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4B)             Consider a semiconductor in the form of a rectangular strip of thickness 10 µm. Let a current of 1        (4)  
  mA flow along its length and a transverse magnetic field of strength 1T be applied across its  
  thickness. If charge carrier density is 3.1 x 1023 m-3, then calculate Hall coefficient and Hall voltage.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4C)             Explain why ferroelectrics are known as non-linear dielectrics. Sketch the ferroelectric hysteresis       (2)  
  loop.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5A)             Explain metallic glass. Write any two property and applications of metallic glass.                        (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5B)             Obtain an expression for rotational energy of a diatomic molecule.                                        (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5C)             Calculate the surface to volume ratio of a spherical body which has radius of 100 nm.                     (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  -----End-----
